operations.title: Erase document history

fields.label: I understand all bitemporal history is destroyed

operations.notes: Erases one document and all its valid-time and system-time history; the row identity comes from the data grid. Read back: no version of the document remains (FOR ALL VALID_TIME FOR ALL SYSTEM_TIME). The table stays listed.
operations.description: Erases one document and all of its valid-time and system-time history; this cannot be undone. The table stays listed.
